children: said on Monday it is expanding its joint venture with KKR
in the United States with an additional renewables portfolio valued at $1.2 billion.
The deal covers three utility-scale solar assets in Texas and Ohio, adding 700 megawatts to the joint venture the companies created in 2025 that currently holds 1.4 gigawatts.
The three solar assets are expected to reach commercial operation by the first quarter of 2027
Electricity from the assets is already sold to third parties or will be marketed by TotalEnergies
TotalEnergies will continue to operate the assets after completion of the transaction, expected in 2026
